name: a plant sketch draws itself to the narration
looks: Inside a plain card, a simple illustration builds piece by piece: two water drops and a tangle of roots ink in first, then a stem and its first leaves, then more leaves and small arrow callouts, each new part landing exactly as a caption line beneath highlights the matching word.
build: hand-drawn-illustration-build: each part is an SVG path revealed with strokeDashoffset then filled, started from the caption's per-word timing rather than a fixed clock; the caption plays karaoke-style beneath, already-spoken words solid, the live word accented.
sound: A soft marker-scratch per stroke, timed to the voice reading the caption.
prompt: Inside a plain card, let a simple illustration draw itself piece by piece, exactly in step with a spoken caption line beneath it, whose words highlight one at a time. Keep every new stroke tied to a specific word, not a fixed timer, so the picture and the voice always agree.
